name: @egress/aggregator
description: Folds every replica's own breaker transitions (published to circuit.control, off the hot path) into one canonical open/closed verdict per apiId and exposes it to Prometheus. Single instance, no HA, no persistence — a real, named SPOF this branch doesn't hide. Never read back into any replica's own decision: protecting the request path and telling the rest of the system about an outage stay different problems.
